value.rationale: The exact globally sharp and strictly monotone 2-to-6 Poisson/periodic variance cost provides parameter-free performance bounds for force-reset frequency regularization in a persistent harmonically confined active particle. It resolves the meaningful distinction between reset-epoch and randomly time-sampled stationary variance and quantifies the magnitude of stochastic-clock variability across the complete domain, rather than recomputing a single arbitrary parameter slice. The general covariance/Jensen sublemmas are acknowledged prior tools, not individually valuable novelties.
